clarity.notes: Each page answers one operator question per zone: breadcrumb (where), PH1 head (what), toolbar (how). Sandbox now exposes the canonical Rows|Cards PillGroup so scan vs browse density is explicit.

hierarchy.notes: Canonical route stack from design-system.html §03/§09: topbar → page head → listing toolbar (search · filters · Rows|Cards) → rows or card grid. One accent CTA per viewport; status on tint pills, never card borders.

typography.notes: Inter UI + JetBrains Mono for refs/endpoints/enums. Mono row/card titles for machine profile names; card Meta eyebrow stays uppercase sans with mono-slug for persistence.

motion.notes: 140ms token transitions, sheet slide, skeleton shimmer. View toggle is instant re-render with aria-pressed sync. Full prefers-reduced-motion guard.

brand.notes: PillGroup matches design-system.html demo (md 24px, borderless track, elevated active, never accent fill). Card anatomy follows CatalogCard: flat canvas-soft, elevated hover, foot meta + Edit action.
